# Security policy

Please report vulnerabilities privately through **Security › Report a vulnerability** on this repository, not in a public issue.

- **In this fork's changes** (branding, polling, the `/now` page, anything on the `spin` branch that isn't in upstream Koito): report here.
- **In Koito itself:** if it also affects upstream, please report it to [gabehf/koito](https://github.com/gabehf/koito) as well, so it gets fixed for everyone.

Only the latest commit on `spin` is supported.
